title: Steelers thought they were getting Makai Lemon, didn't realize Eagles had cut the line

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Steelers thought they were getting Makai Lemon, didn't realize Eagles had cut the line
sources.description: As the Steelers moved quickly with the truncated window to make their first pick in the 2026 draft, they didn't know the guy they wanted was already gone.
